title: IF NECESSARY, GRIND AND HONE MAIN JOURNALS AND/OR CRANK PINS
ocr_text:
EM-84
ENGINE MECHANICAL (2JZ-GTE)  -  CYLINDER BLOCK

18.  IF NECESSARY, GRIND AND HONE MAIN
     JOURNALS AND/OR CRANK PINS
(a)  Grind and hone the main journals and/or crank pins to the
     finished undersized diameter
     (See procedure step 17).
(b)  Install new main journal and/or crank pin undersized
     bearings.
